reviewer_schema_edges.purpose: Check the locked all-or-nothing rule against the current Claude request schema beyond the submitted shape-only cases.
failed_scenarios: input_image with unsupported application/pdf media_type remained structured
input_image with malformed base64 data remained structured
input_file with unsupported text/plain base64 media_type remained structured
input_file with raw non-base64 data became an application/octet-stream base64 document
Claude text document source without required text/plain media_type remained structured
valid Claude document source.content containing an image block was downgraded to compact JSON text

tests.locked_contract_coverage_assessment: The submitted table exercises strings, empty arrays, mapped OpenAI parts, selected Claude-native blocks, arbitrary objects, scalar values, unknown arrays, invalid arrays, mixed arrays, nested arrays, and nested content:[]. It does not prove that every accepted structured member is schema-valid or that every valid Claude-native tool-result block stays structured.

verified_constraints: Base64 image media_type is limited to image/jpeg, image/png, image/gif, or image/webp and data is byte/base64 formatted.
Base64 document source is application/pdf and data is byte/base64 formatted.
Plain-text document source requires media_type text/plain.
Document source.content accepts text and image items.
Tool-result content also accepts tool_reference blocks with required tool_name.

upstream_comparison.note: The cached upstream helper was compared but was not treated as authority; the reviewed result intentionally adds all-or-nothing fallback behavior beyond that cached implementation.

Major.title: Schema-invalid image and document sources are emitted as structured Claude blocks
Major.scenario: A tool returns an input_image data URI with media_type application/pdf or malformed base64, an input_file with text/plain, arbitrary raw data, or malformed base64, or a Claude text document source without media_type text/plain. The converter treats each member as valid and emits a structured image/document block instead of compacting the original array to text.
Major.impact: The generated request violates the Claude Messages request schema and can be rejected by the provider. Because tool output is commonly external or untrusted, malformed output can reliably turn the next model request into an availability failure. This violates the locked rule that arrays remain structured only when every member maps to a valid Claude content block.
Major.evidence: All five reviewer invalid-schema subtests failed because the output remained structured; the submitted focused and package tests still passed.
Major.required_change: Validate base64 syntax and exact media-type enums before accepting structured blocks. Base64 images must use image/jpeg, image/png, image/gif, or image/webp; base64 documents must be application/pdf; text documents must carry text/plain. If validity cannot be established, fall back the entire original array to compact JSON text.

Major.title: Some valid Claude-native tool-result blocks are downgraded to JSON text
Major.scenario: A tool returns a valid document block whose source.type is content and whose content contains an image block. The Claude schema permits text and image members, but validClaudeToolResultTextBlocks accepts only text, so the whole array becomes opaque JSON text. Likewise, a valid tool_reference block with a tool_name is unrecognized and becomes text.
Major.impact: Valid structured media or tool-reference semantics are lost, contrary to the locked rule that an array stays structured when every member maps to a valid Claude content block.
Major.evidence: The reviewer document-content image test failed with a string fallback. The official tool-result content union also includes tool_reference, while the converter switch has no such case.
Major.required_change: Validate document content-source members against the actual text-or-image union, preserve empty content arrays, and handle other in-scope valid Claude tool-result variants such as tool_reference rather than treating them as unknown.

Minor.title: Submitted tests prove value-shape branches but not Claude schema validity
Minor.scenario: The tests use one valid image media type, one valid PDF media type, and selected native blocks. They omit malformed base64, unsupported media types, required document media fields, document content with image members, and other valid tool-result variants.
Minor.impact: The evidence suite reports PASS while both schema-invalid acceptance and valid-block rejection remain present.
Minor.required_change: Add table cases for the failed reviewer scenarios and assert the all-or-nothing compact-text fallback or structured preservation required by the locked contract.

security_assessment.note: No code-execution, secret-handling, or JSON-injection issue was found. The material security-relevant concern is availability: externally controlled tool output can produce provider-rejected Claude requests because schema-invalid blocks are forwarded structurally.

conclusion: Integrity and reconstruction proofs pass, and the declared tests reproduce successfully. Changes are requested because the implementation does not enforce Claude schema validity for accepted structured media/document blocks and rejects some valid native blocks, so the locked all-or-nothing contract is not met.
